attributes.blockerTitle: Alias rows resolved — layer-03 gap is genuine
attributes.detail: Tested 2026-08-24 against the concept data. Of 174 bare single-word rows matrix-wide, only **3** are defensible absorptions (`List → Card List`, `Chart → Line Chart`, `Search → Search Cards`), now carrying `scope: alias`. Thirteen more have a sibling that is itself unbuilt, so collapsing them moves no number, and **40 bare rows have no sibling anywhere** — they are an unexpanded vocabulary (Money, Quote, Proposal, Plan, Email, Call, Role, Workflow, Filter, Sort, Group…), not double-counting. The layer-03 numbers can be read at face value and the demand-weighted build list does not shrink. Decision recorded in bottom-up-block-strategy.md §7.5.
